item.title: Parolee wearing GPS monitor charged after attempted car burglary in Evanston: police
item.description: A 21-year-old with a GPS monitoring device has been charged after an attempted car burglary investigation, according to Evanston police.On Feb. 24, police responded to the 700 block of Hinman Avenue for a report of a man attempting to open doors of parked cars around 10:11 a.m. A local resident reported seeing a man, later identified as Jonathan Curtis, of Skokie, walking south in the west alley, looking suspicious.An officer found Curtis that matched the description in the area and stopped him.

item.title: Family creates support fund after fatal crash rocks dance community
item.description: A deadly rollover crash on the Bishop Ford Freeway last week has left Chicago’s dance community in mourning.Illinois State Police say the SUV was carrying five dancers when the driver lost control and flipped. Seventeen-year-old Boaz "Bo" Flemister and 25-year-old dance director Lazarus "Hollywood" Gonzalez were ejected and pronounced dead at the scene. item.title: 37-year-old shot while sitting in car on West Side: police
item.description: A 37-year-old man is in critical condition after being shot while inside a car in the Austin neighborhood on Friday, according to Chicago police.In the 1000 block of N. Leamington Ave., a 37-year-old man was inside a car around 5:24 p.m. when he was struck by gunfire from an unknown suspect.The victim sustained a gunshot wound to the back and was transported to Mt. Sinai Hospital in critical condition, police said.Area Four Detectives are investigating the incident.

item.title: Suburban nature center announces the death of beloved swan
item.description: Lake Katherine Nature Center announced on Friday that a swan passed away on their lake in Palos Heights.According to a Facebook post, the suburban nature center said that the swan was removed from the lake, although they are unsure what the animal died of.
